intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies and no difficulty trophies. The order below follows the official descriptions: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and clean-up. Only one trophy can be missed.

stages.text: Before you start: turn on every progress and collectible notification in Settings, so WAiNK scans, stunts and meditations count out loud. Never use cheats on your trophy save — they switch off trophies and saving. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one from just before the final mission; there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and the game gives you 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
stages.title: Set up the run

stages.text: Play Chapter 1: Gone Fishing, then meet Cal (Feng Shui) and Kenton (Key Lento, 7 shipwrecks). Do NOT skip Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — follow her from the kitchen to the balcony and accept it. It is gone after Chapter 1 and it may be the one meditation Positive Mental Attitude needs. Keep a Chapter 1 save until that trophy pops.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — the one thing you can miss

stages.text: Both characters are playable after Coffee Break. From here: call your partner in for anything that needs two people, meditate with both characters at each spot (it counts twice), scan traffic with WAiNK as you drive, and start the side strands — Billy at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kingpin Bowling (Hit Kingpin Bowling), Moses and the Scooter Bros app, garages in the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver. Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment it appears; it is time-sensitive.
stages.title: Chapter 2 — the world opens up

stages.text: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies (Sneakthief, Retail Therapy). Randy's Wish List opens after the Key Cloner mission — deliver his 16 sports cars. Tyrone's labs appear after Here, Kitty Kitty. Andy's quests start when he texts Lucia. Credit Check gets you the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
stages.title: Chapter 3 — tools of the trade

stages.text: Bank vaults open with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — follow a security van, get in while it is open, and bring your partner (the haul is too heavy alone). Vaults always give 4 stars, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. Finish the chapter missions: Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown.
stages.title: Chapter 4 — vaults and heists

stages.text: Complete Operation Savage Glory, then the final mission. Free roam carries on after the credits, so everything left on the list stays doable — except the Chapter 1 meditation, which is why stage 2 mattered.
stages.title: Chapter 5 and the finale

stages.text: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work through what is left: every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, plus 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. This is the longest stretch — around 100 hours — and most of the miscellaneous trophies pop along the way.
stages.title: After the credits — the 100% checklist

stages.text: Stranger missions are not part of 100%, but Strangers & Freaks needs 8 qualifying strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Finish the character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and sweep the remaining one-offs: the cocktail on Ocean Beach, the showroom smash, the bowling alley valuables, the gym with your partner.
stages.title: Strangers, finales and clean-up
